name: BLS Polymers Limited
summary: Goa-based maker of custom polymer compounds for power/telecom cables and 3LPE pipeline coating; ₹255 Cr fresh issue.
financials: FY26 revenue ₹349 Cr (+6% on FY25), PAT about ₹27 Cr; full P&L not extracted.
positives: CPSE enlistments are a barrier to entry
Wire and cable demand from power and telecom
red_flags: Single Goa plant; untraceable records and shareholders
Growth is single-digit; ₹89.5 Cr of proceeds go to working capital
anchor: Anchors ₹76.5 Cr, 7 small AIFs/offshore funds (weak grade)
